result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but the promotional banner has a serious text-contrast problem: white headline and subtitle text sit on a very light mint-green background, making them hard to read. There is also a small inconsistency in the favorite (heart) button styling between cards.

issues.description: In the '3 free deliveries for you' promo banner, the white headline and the white subtitle ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') are placed on a pale mint-green background, resulting in very low contrast. The subtitle in particular is nearly illegible.
issues.suggestion: Use dark text (e.g., dark green/near-black) on the light banner background, or darken/saturate the banner background so white text meets WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1 for body text).

issues.description: The favorite/heart button is inconsistent between the 'Popular right now' cards: on the ramen card it appears as a bare white outline icon, while on the pizza card it sits inside a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent treatment (e.g., always a semi-transparent dark circular backdrop) to the heart button so it remains visible and uniform over any image.
